scholarships.title: CAS-ANSO Scholarship (Degree Program) 2026
scholarships.official_source: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS)

existing.description: The CAS-ANSO Scholarship (Degree Program), previously the ANSO Scholarship for Young Talents, is the postgraduate scholarship of the Alliance of National and International Science Organizations for the Belt and Road Regions (ANSO), sponsored by the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) and administered at the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS) for master's and PhD study. The 2026 call opened for application on 15 October 2025 and closed for applicants and referees on 31 January 2026 Beijing Time; results were announced in June 2026 and the 2027 call was not yet published on 2026-10-04. The 2026 coverage table published on the call page lists tuition waiver, a monthly stipend of CNY 6,000 or 7,000 for PhD candidates and CNY 3,000 for master's candidates, health insurance, application fee waiver, one international travel allowance and a one-time visa/residence permit allowance. A sub-category, the ANSO-CAS-TWAS/UNESCO PhD Scholarship, selects up to 40 PhD students from developing countries each year, with 10 scholarships prioritised for recipients engaged in climate-related research.
eligibility: Does NOT hold Chinese citizenship and holds a valid foreign passport
Friendly to China and abiding by Chinese laws and decrees and UCAS rules and regulations
Meets the admission criteria for international students of UCAS
Not currently pursuing a master's degree at any university/institution in China (for the master's program) or a doctoral degree (for the PhD program)
Does not take up other assignments during the scholarship period
Is not applying for the CAS-ANSO Scholarship through both USTC and UCAS simultaneously
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must not hold Chinese citizenship, must hold a valid foreign passport, must be proficient in English or Chinese, and must meet the UCAS admission criteria for international students. Master's applicants must be born after 1 January 1996 (inclusive) and PhD applicants after 1 January 1991 (inclusive). Applicants currently pursuing a master's or doctoral degree at any institution in China are barred from the corresponding level of this scholarship, and applying through both USTC and UCAS simultaneously leads to disqualification.
benefits: Monthly stipend of CNY 6,000 or 7,000 for PhD candidates
Monthly stipend of CNY 3,000 for master's candidates
One international travel allowance from home country to China
coverage: Tuition waiver for both the PhD program and the Master's program
PhD monthly stipend: CNY 6,000 or 7,000 per month depending on whether the qualification test has been passed, of which CNY 1,000 is provided by the CAS Institute, up to 48 months
Master's monthly stipend: CNY 3,000 per month, up to 36 months
International travel allowance from the awardee's home country to China, one trip per awarded candidate
requirements: Meet the admission criteria for international students of UCAS for 2026 Programs for International Students
Select 'the CAS-ANSO Scholarship' in the UCAS online application
Tick the additional box if consideration as an ANSO-CAS-TWAS/UNESCO PhD Scholarship candidate is wanted
Submit the file and application in the UCAS Online Admission System before the deadline
application_method: Apply through the UCAS Online Admission System for International Students at https://is.ucas.ac.cn/#/login
Choose 'the CAS-ANSO Scholarship' in the application form
Tick the ANSO-CAS-TWAS/UNESCO PhD Scholarship box if relevant
File and submit the application in the system before the deadline
existing.selection_notes: Any awardee who fails annual assessments faces consequences including termination of the scholarship, discontinuity of study, and being provided with a certificate of attendance for the period of study undertaken in China but not a formal degree. Awardees must complete centralised training in Chinese language, Chinese culture and all required credits plus practical research and a degree thesis at UCAS colleges and schools or CAS institutes.
existing.notes: The itemised 2026 coverage table on the official page is published as an image (/images/2025/202510/133327_766014_1.png), not as HTML text. It gives two different stipend rates by degree level, so no single funding_amount figure is published; both rates are recorded in coverage[] and benefits[]. For ANSO-CAS-TWAS/UNESCO PhD Scholarship awardees, coverage items 1 to 4 are sponsored by CAS and items 5 and 6, if eligible, are sponsored by TWAS/UNESCO; for all other CAS-ANSO Scholarship awardees items 1 to 6 are covered by CAS.
existing.duration: PhD: monthly stipend for up to 48 months. Master's: monthly stipend for up to 36 months. The official page states the scholarship duration explicitly in the Admission Notice.
existing.application_period: 15 October 2025 to 31 January 2026 (Beijing Time) for the 2026 cycle. The 2027 window was not published on 2026-10-04.
existing.deadline_display: Deadline for Applicants and Referees: 31st January 2026 (Beijing Time) for the 2026 cycle, which has now closed. The 2027 call was not published on the UCAS site on 2026-10-04.
